about: Golden outputs recorded from FontVibe's production TypeScript implementation (the code behind fontvibe.ai/tools/rune-generator). Both ports must reproduce every case byte for byte. Regenerating this file is not part of the build; it is the reference.
exhaustive_note: Input is every Unicode scalar value U+0000..U+10FFFF except surrogates, in order, concatenated into one string. Hashes are SHA-256 of the UTF-8 output.
